description.text: Fashion Design Program is the comprehensive specialty involving garment design, accessories design, fashion, image design, marketing, management and fashion show. The course blends individual creativity and commercial realism, and you will be able to apply your skills and knowledge of the professional design process, from concept to product and attributes to succeed in a wide range of careers in the fashion industry. Learning outcomes To help you develop a good foundation of fashion knowledge and skills in both design and technical areas To grasp the basic methods of Fashion and prediction of fashion To understand the basic operation knowledge of garment enterprises and market To have ability to produce garments that reflect your personal direction as a creative fashion design graduate Core Curriculum Introduction to fashion, Fashion accessories Design, Marketing, Image Design, Brand Clothing Design, Garment construction, Professional Software，Apparel Structure Design Future Career Our graduates go into a range of fashion-related roles. Here are some recent examples: Clothing Designers Buyers and procurement officers Image designers

duration.text: The Fashion Design at Liaoning Communication University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: The following materials have to be prepared, photocopies or fax submissions are accepted, the original documents can be submitted after acceptance of admission. (1) Application form for Foreigners Wishing to Study in of Liaoning Communication University (2) The first page and one blank page of the passport (3) Physical Examination Record for Foreigners (4) Certificate of highest academic degree obtained and transcript of academic record (In English or in Chinese) (5) 2-inch color photos (6) Financial Proof or other warranty to ensure the students can cover all the expenses during their study in China (7) The above materials should be written in English or in Chinese, or attach a translation in either of the two languages. Relevant forms are available from Chinese Embassies, consulates or LNCU

requirements.text: All applicants must be in good health. (1) Undergraduate Programs 4 years ( in English Medium): Under the age of 30, a high school graduate or with equivalent qualification of 12-year education background. (2) Undergraduate Programs 4 years ( in Chinese Medium): HSK level 6 required (3) Non-degree Chinese Language Course: No prerequisite required.
